problem_text:
A logistics firm must coordinate a specialized courier network linking nine regional distribution hubs.

The travel durations between hubs are recorded in minutes:
* Hub Alpha to Beta: 169.3 minutes
* Alpha to Gamma: 120.6 minutes
* Alpha to Delta: 140.4 minutes
* Alpha to Epsilon: 122.3 minutes
* Alpha to Zeta: 144.8 minutes
* Alpha to Eta: 99.0 minutes
* Alpha to Theta: 88.6 minutes
* Alpha to Iota: 166.5 minutes
* Beta to Gamma: 95.0 minutes
* Beta to Delta: 121.2 minutes
* Beta to Epsilon: 137.0 minutes
* Beta to Zeta: 43.3 minutes
* Beta to Eta: 208.1 minutes
* Beta to Theta: 89.5 minutes
* Beta to Iota: 130.6 minutes
* Gamma to Delta: 165.1 minutes
* Gamma to Epsilon: 166.1 minutes
* Gamma to Zeta: 106.6 minutes
* Gamma to Eta: 200.4 minutes
* Gamma to Theta: 95.1 minutes
* Gamma to Iota: 185.9 minutes
* Delta to Epsilon: 26.1 minutes
* Delta to Zeta: 78.3 minutes
* Delta to Eta: 113.7 minutes
* Delta to Theta: 73.1 minutes
* Delta to Iota: 26.2 minutes
* Epsilon to Zeta: 93.9 minutes
* Epsilon to Eta: 87.7 minutes
* Epsilon to Theta: 71.0 minutes
* Epsilon to Iota: 47.8 minutes
* Zeta to Eta: 168.4 minutes
* Zeta to Theta: 57.0 minutes
* Zeta to Iota: 90.1 minutes
* Eta to Theta: 121.0 minutes
* Eta to Iota: 132.1 minutes
* Theta to Iota: 97.0 minutes

The objective is to determine the most time-efficient inspection circuit that allows a supervisor to visit every hub precisely once, concluding the tour at the initial point of departure.
